en-US.pack.sunny_home_garden_2.title: Sunny Home Garden 2
en-US.pack.sunny_home_garden_2.summary: A gentle second pack for little hands: two four-step lessons with Puff and Moss — point to familiar things, and sort the same kind together. Stored on this device only.
en-US.character.puff.name: Puff
en-US.character.moss.name: Moss
en-US.character.puff.line_1: Hello, friend! Shall we wave hello together?
en-US.character.puff.line_2: Look what is in my flower basket — let us see together!
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.silhouette: Soft cloud-shaped fluffy body made of overlapping rounded cloud puffs; fluffy cloud arms that often wave hello. Round and soft, reads as a cloud at thumbnail size.
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.palette: Body soft white (#FBFCFE); shading light sky-blue (#A9D3F0); eyes brown (#6B4A2F); cheeks pink (#F2A7B4).
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.outfit: Striped sky-blue scarf — this is the whole outfit; no other clothing.
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.prop: Small basket of flowers; the only prop.
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.face: Round friendly face, big brown eyes, pink cheeks, gentle happy expression.
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.movement: Fluffy cloud arms often wave hello; bright and bouncy.
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.hard_negativ: Never a human child, never a person; no hair, no necklace, no human ears, no legs or feet.
en-US.character.moss.line_1: What does our little sprout need today? Let us look together.
en-US.character.moss.line_2: We can water gently and take our time.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.silhouette: Round mushroom-cap sprite — a terracotta-brown mushroom cap with cream spots on top of a cream round face and body; reads as a round mushroom at thumbnail size.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.palette: Cap terracotta-brown (#B5651D); spots, face and body cream (#F7EBD6); eyes brown (#6B4A2F); cheeks pink (#F2A7B4); vest sage-green (#9CAF88); shorts brown (#6B4A2F).
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.outfit: Little sage-green vest over brown shorts — fully dressed; no other clothing.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.prop: Small potted sprout and a small silver watering can.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.face: Cream round face, big brown eyes, pink cheeks, warm friendly smile.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.movement: Sways gently while waiting; warm, friendly, and patient.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.hard_negativ: Never a human child, never a person; no hair, no necklace, no human ears (the cap is the head); no bare torso (always vested).

en-US.lesson.words_that_sound_the_same.title: Words That Sound the Same!
Cat, hat! They sound the same. Tap the hat!
You found the hat — hat sounds like cat!
Dog, frog! They sound the same. Tap the frog!
You found the frog — frog sounds like dog!
Find the picture that sounds like moon!
You found the spoon — spoon sounds like moon!
Find the picture that sounds like star!
You found the car — car sounds like star!
Find the picture that sounds like bee!
You found the tree — tree sounds like bee!
en-US.lesson.words_that_sound_the_same.closing: Words that sound the same — you heard them all!

en-US.mission.table_helpers.child_prompt: Let us set our table together, one light thing at a time.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.parent_script: Put the device down. Together with your child, set out a simple table for a snack or meal a grown-up has already prepared. Now: napkins down together. Next: plates and cups down together. Name “Now, Next, done!” together.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.precheck: Please confirm there is no glass, no knives, and no hot items on the table yet, and a grown-up stays beside your child throughout.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.return_ritual: Now, next, done — we did it together! Puff and Moss hum your goodnight song fragment with you.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.safety_1: A grown-up places anything heavy, hot, or breakable.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.safety_2: Your child carries one light, unbreakable item at a time.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.safety_3: Dry wet hands before carrying anything.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.safety_4: You can stop anytime and still celebrate together.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.team_goal: Set a simple table together for a snack a grown-up has already prepared.

en-US.mission.tidy_team.child_prompt: Let us put our things away in two groups together.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.parent_script: Put the device down. Together with your child, choose one rule — colours first, or kinds on another day. Take turns: your child puts one thing in, you put one thing in, until six things sit in two groups. Name the two groups together out loud.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.precheck: Please confirm the floor is clear, the items are large and soft with no small parts, and a grown-up stays beside your child throughout.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.return_ritual: We did it together — Puff and Moss hum your song fragment with you.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.safety_1: Check the floor for small objects before you begin.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.safety_2: No climbing to reach high shelves — keep everything at child height.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.safety_3: If anything breaks or spills, stop and clean up together, celebrating the help.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.team_goal: Sort six friendly things into two groups as a team.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.title: Tidy Team
en-US.mission.water_plants.child_prompt: Let us give our plant a small drink together.
en-US.mission.water_plants.parent_script: Put the device down. With a small, grown-up-filled vessel, care for a plant together: now a little drink, next a gentle wipe of the leaves. Use the highest level your home has — a small cup, a small watering can, or a damp cloth.
en-US.mission.water_plants.precheck: Please confirm the plant is safe — not toxic, not spiky, within reach without climbing — any water is a small grown-up-filled amount, and a grown-up stays beside your child throughout.
en-US.mission.water_plants.return_ritual: The plant had its drink — we did it together! Puff and Moss hum your song fragment with you.
en-US.mission.water_plants.safety_1: A grown-up checks the plant is not toxic or spiky first.
en-US.mission.water_plants.safety_2: No tasting soil — watering is for the plant only.
en-US.mission.water_plants.safety_3: Wipe spills immediately and keep water away from sockets and devices.
en-US.mission.water_plants.team_goal: Care for a plant together with a small drink and a gentle wipe.
en-US.mission.water_plants.title: Watering Team
en-US.picture_set.home_things.title: Home Things
en-US.routine.goodnight_garden.child_prompt: Let us get ready for bed together, one kind step at a time.
en-US.routine.goodnight_garden.parent_script: A calm, parent-led wind-down. On the device: Moss shows three picture cards and sings the first line of the goodnight song. Then put the device down — the routine does not need the screen after the start.
en-US.routine.goodnight_garden.return_ritual: You came back! Puff and Moss sing your song fragment together to welcome you.
en-US.routine.goodnight_garden.safety_1: Keep the lights low and soft for the last step, and an adult stays with the child until they are settled.
en-US.routine.goodnight_garden.team_goal: Wind down for bed together: tidy one thing, share a quiet book or song, and dim the lights.

en-US.lesson.add_take_away.step_2.celebration: Two! Three cups take one away leaves two cups!
en-US.lesson.add_take_away.step_3.prompt: Moss has two books. Two more books arrive. How many books now?
en-US.lesson.add_take_away.step_3.celebration: Four! Two books and two more make four books!
en-US.lesson.add_take_away.step_4.prompt: Moss has four balls. Two balls roll away. How many balls now?
en-US.lesson.add_take_away.step_4.celebration: Two! Four balls take two away leaves two balls!
en-US.lesson.add_take_away.step_5.prompt: Moss has three cups. Two more cups arrive. How many cups now?
en-US.lesson.add_take_away.step_5.celebration: Five! Three cups and two more make five cups!

en-US.lesson.final_sounds.step_4.prompt: Cup! What sound does 'cup' end with? Tap the letter that makes that sound!
en-US.lesson.final_sounds.step_5.prompt: Leaf! What sound does 'leaf' end with? Tap the letter that makes that sound!
